title: Pinned real Ribasim heterogeneous physical realization factors

dependency_gate.implementation_rule: No DUMMY-19D generator, verifier or workflow gate before DUMMY-19C closes and the implementation baseline is rebound.

purpose: Test the pinned real Ribasim physical UserDemand layer when two fully allocated demands share one source Basin but have different min_level values, so physical reduction factors are unequal and the common-factor proportional result from DUMMY-19C no longer applies.

independent_continuous_reference.ledger: 60 m3 fixed inflow = root supplied + external supplied + Basin storage gain.

hypotheses: Both priority cases fully allocate 40 m3/day root and 20 m3/day external demand, as in DUMMY-19C.
Physical supplied flows are not proportional to allocation because the two UserDemand nodes have different min_level values and therefore different source-state reduction factors.
Initial physical factors are exactly 0.5 for root and 0.15625 for external demand.
Integrated one-day physical supplies are approximately 20.0552364 m3 root and 3.1457475 m3 external, with a preregistered 0.05 m3 tolerance on each integrated volume.
Final Basin level is approximately 1.000036799016 m and storage gain approximately 36.7990161 m3.
Reversing demand_priority does not change the physical supplies or Basin trajectory when both demands remain fully allocated.
The common-factor proportional realization structure qualified by DUMMY-19C is therefore not general: current pinned Ribasim physical realization is source-state/link specific.
Allocated-but-unsupplied volumes remain diagnostic only and do not enter the physical ledger.
measurements: direct Basin-to-root and Basin-to-external physical linkflow time series
boundaries: different min_level values but identical source Basin
no network reallocation after physical shortfall
